user.title: Sign in to Panasonic account
user.description: Enter the credentials for your Panasonic Smart app account (China mainland). The session is cached after the first login and can be reused when adding more devices later.

device.title: Select ERV device
device.description: The device list for this account has been loaded. Select the Panasonic ERV device you want to add. If you captured a device token, you can also enter it here to override the auto-generated value.

error.cannot_connect: Login failed: check your account credentials or network connection
error.no_devices_found: No devices found: verify that devices are bound to this account
error.no_supported_devices_found: No supported ERV devices found: only 0800/0850 category SmallERV and MidERV devices are currently supported
error.token_generation_failed: Token generation failed: the device ID format is invalid
